name: Jenner Analytics
description:
Jenner is a SAS-compatible analytics engine. This connector lets Claude validate SAS syntax, execute SAS programs against datasets in your Jenner workspace, and retrieve a durable audit record for any run.

It is aimed at clinical and regulated analytics, where the output alone is not sufficient: every execution returns an audit id that resolves to the exact program text, the full SAS log, and a content hash of the inputs, so a result can be reproduced and defended later.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Jenner Analytics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Jenner Analytics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://workspace.jenneranalytics.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Jenner Analytics MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Jenner Analytics provides these MCP tools: execute_sas_program, get_execution_audit, ping, and validate_sas_program.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Jenner Analytics?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Jenner Analytics in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Jenner Analytics MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Jenner Analytics requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Jenner Analytics is developed by Jenner Analytics. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
